facts.fact: ANAM describes its ten-day agro-meteorological bulletin for Burkina Faso as a current product carrying NDVI and NDVI anomalies with rainfall, temperature and humidity anomalies.
ANAM publishes the bulletin every ten days, the newest listed update covering 13-19 October 2026.

BFA.note: The page names NDVI in an agro-meteorological bulletin but states no satellite use in forecasts or warnings by the weather service.
